purpose: W2P-004 stability validation: 180s sleep with periodic ticks. Tests that worker pulls within 10s, claims, runs, and updates result.json every ~3s during a multi-minute job. Agent verifies via Drive MCP read_file_content (NO colab-mcp).
cmd: echo 'STABILITY TEST STARTED'; date; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do sleep 30; echo "tick $i at $(date +%H:%M:%S)"; done; touch /tmp/test-stability-sleep-180.done; echo 'STABILITY TEST DONE'; date
